title: Data Repositories & Portals
blurb: General platforms that host or index many health datasets — good places to keep searching.

items.name: PhysioNet
items.description: The home of MIMIC, eICU and hundreds of open and credentialed physiological, clinical and imaging datasets, plus annual Computing in Cardiology challenges.
items.access_note: Mixed: each dataset is Open, Restricted (registration + DUA) or Credentialed.

items.name: UCI Machine Learning Repository
items.description: Long-running repository of 600+ curated datasets, including dozens of classic clinical ones (breast cancer Wisconsin, heart disease, diabetes, CKD, hepatitis).

items.name: Grand Challenge
items.description: Platform hosting hundreds of biomedical image-analysis challenges with downloadable datasets and leaderboard evaluation.
items.access_note: Free account; each challenge sets its own data terms.

items.name: Synapse
items.description: Collaborative research platform hosting data for DREAM challenges, AMP-AD, BraTS and many consortia, with fine-grained access controls.
items.access_note: Free account; some datasets need certified-user quiz or data-use approval.

items.name: Kaggle Datasets
items.description: Community data platform with thousands of medical datasets and competition data (RSNA, SIIM, APTOS, PANDA) plus free GPU notebooks.
items.access_note: Free account; licences vary — check provenance carefully.

items.name: ICPSR
items.description: The world's largest archive of social and behavioural science data, including health and ageing collections (NACDA) and many NIH-funded studies.
items.access_note: Free account for public-use files; restricted files by application.

items.name: UK Data Service
items.description: UK's largest collection of social, economic and population data — including ELSA, Understanding Society, Health Survey for England and birth cohorts.
items.access_note: Free registration (international users welcome for most safeguarded data).

items.name: Health Data Research Gateway
items.description: Searchable catalogue of UK health datasets (NHS, cohorts, biobanks, trials) with standardised metadata and a common data-access request workflow.
items.access_note: Catalogue open; access to each dataset via the custodian's application process (some may charge).

items.name: Registry of Open Data on AWS (life sciences)
items.description: Cloud-hosted public datasets you can analyse in place — e.g. gnomAD, 1000 Genomes, TCGA open tier, CAMELYON, EMBED, NIH CXR.
items.access_note: Mostly open; some entries require approval from the data owner.

items.name: Zenodo
items.description: CERN-run general-purpose open repository where many medical datasets (TotalSegmentator, CODE-15%, COUGHVID…) are deposited with DOIs.
items.access_note: Open; per-record licences and occasional restricted access.
